guernsey-law holds no Guernsey, Alderney or Sark Law or Ordinance: it holds 107 UK statutory instruments about Guernsey as made, a catalogue of 182 such instruments, and 12 Wikidata facts, so none of the essentials is present and there is no case law. The one UK Order checked matches legislation.gov.uk word for word in its articles, but its Schedule drops the inserted Schedule 3 (13 boundary points) and loses the number of a substituted section.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
